# GodotGo Copilot instructions

GodotGo is a workspace for building Godot 4 games: a reusable framework, several sample games, project-aware tooling and a Claude Code integration. `CLAUDE.md` at the repo root is the authoritative agent guide; keep this file consistent with it.

## Layout

The repository root is **not** a Godot project. A project is any directory with a `project.godot`:

- `framework/` — the shared addon `addons/godotgo` plus its own tests
- `games/orb-run` (3D), `games/leap` (2D platformer), `games/swarm` (2D shooter), `games/shift` (grid puzzle)
- `templates/blank/` — what `tools/new_game.sh` copies

Every game symlinks `addons/godotgo` to `framework/addons/godotgo`.

The workspace targets Godot 4.7.2, pinned once in `tools/lib.sh` and fetched by `tools/install_godot.sh` into `.godot-bin/`. Every project declares the matching `config/features`.

## Commands

Every tool takes a project name (the directory under `games/`, or `framework`); omitting it means all of them.

- `tools/verify.sh [project]` — check + test + smoke, the gate CI runs
- `tools/check.sh [project] [file ...]` — import, load every script/scene/resource in a live SceneTree, gdlint, gdformat
- `tools/test.sh [project] [filter]` — headless tests
- `tools/smoke.sh [project]` — windowless boot
- `tools/run.sh <project> [scene]` — play
- `tools/new_game.sh <slug> --title T` — scaffold a verified new game
- `python3 tools/gen_assets.py [project]` — regenerate placeholder art and audio
- `tools/docker.sh <cmd>` — the same, in the container CI uses
- `tools/claude.sh <fix|build|improve|review|new>` — drive Claude Code, gated on verification

## Architecture

Gameplay rules live in each game's `scripts/game.gd`, a subclass of the framework `Session` registered as the autoload `Game`. Scenes wire themselves to it and react to its signals, so rules are testable without a display. Reuse the framework rather than reimplementing: `Session`, `SaveSystem`, `ObjectPool`, `StateMachine`, `Rng`, `TextGrid`, `DebugOverlay`, `GodotGoTest`.

## Conventions

- Tabs. Static typing everywhere. `##` doc comments on public members.
- `&"action"` for input actions and signals, `^"Path"` for node paths, `@export_range` for tunables.
- gdlint member order: signals, constants, exports, public vars, private vars, `@onready`, methods.
- Never invent a `uid://`; generate one with `res://addons/godotgo/tools/new_uid.gd`.
- Commit `.gd.uid` sidecars and `.import` files; never commit `.godot/`.
- Placeholder art is generated by `tools/gen_assets.py`, never hand-drawn; CI fails if the committed bytes differ from a fresh run.
- Physics layers: 1 world, 2 player, 3 pickups, 4 triggers, game-specific from 5 up.
- A project with no tests fails `tools/test.sh`; an empty suite must never look like a passing one.
